name: PT Rig Tenders Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Rig Tenders Indonesia Tbk provides marine logistics services for the oil and coal industry in Indonesia. It offers offshore support services, including seismic survey support; anchor handling; mobilization/de-mobilization, towing, assisting, and mooring of FPSO, FSO, tankers, platforms, and rigs; preform fire-fighting and oil spill recovery; running cargoes to platforms and rigs; supply of food and fresh water; transportation for personnel, bulk, and deck cargoes; chartering of offshore accommodation barges; maintenance support; and protecting, patrolling, and supporting pipe line laying, as well as protecting oil and gas fields from unnecessary ships and boats.
